country_code.description: The [ISO-3166-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) country code of the country.

uri.description: The URI of the Country resource, relative to `https://api.twilio.com`.

beta.description: Whether all phone numbers available in the country are new to the Twilio platform. `true` if they are and `false` if all numbers are not in the Twilio Phone Number Beta program.

subresource_uris.description: A list of related AvailablePhoneNumber resources identified by their URIs relative to `https://api.twilio.com`.
